reference.description: on the four PAMAP2 subject-101 ankle-acceleration activity signals, recurrenceQuantification (m=4, tau=8, target RR=0.1) + approximate/sample entropy reproduce the per-activity determinism + entropy table and its gaps; DET/LAM/ApEn land on the case's published numbers (an independent base-R ApEn matches the op to machine precision)
